items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: we used to come on at night at 11:30, right behind Lawrence Welk and his seven piece band

ctx.x: In Chicago. Right. We have talked a little bit about that, but let's go into that a little more, if you will. Who were some of the people that were playing with you at that time in the Swingland in '37, if you recall?

Yes. That was a place where we broadcast in Chicago, from Radio Station WBBM, and Swingland was a nightclub similar to Connie's Inn in New York City, because they had some great revues. We played shows there, and I had a big band at that time, and we used to come on at night at 11:30, right behind Lawrence Welk and his seven piece band, and Lawrence was on the squeeze box.
